question: Which of the following organs secretes bile juice?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Liver**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The liver is a vital organ in the human body that plays a major role in metabolism and has several functions in the body, including detoxification, protein synthesis, and the production of biochemicals necessary for digestion.
 
• Bile juice is produced by the liver and stored in the gallbladder. It helps in the digestion of fats in the small intestine.
 
• The liver is the largest internal organ and gland in the human body, weighing about 1.5 kg in adults.
 
• The liver has the unique ability to regenerate, allowing it to regain full size even after surgical removal or injury.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bile Juice:**

 
 
• Bile juice is a digestive fluid produced by the liver and stored in the gallbladder.
 
• It contains bile acids, which are critical for digestion and absorption of fats and fat-soluble vitamins in the small intestine.
 
• Bile also contains cholesterol, bilirubin (a breakdown product of red blood cells), and other substances that are eventually excreted from the body.
 
• When food enters the small intestine, bile is released from the gallbladder into the small intestine to aid in digestion.
 
 
 
• **Liver Functions:**
 
 
• The liver is responsible for producing bile, which helps carry away waste and break down fats in the small intestine during digestion.
 
• It produces certain proteins for blood plasma, stores and releases glucose as needed, and processes hemoglobin for use of its iron content.
 
• The liver also converts harmful ammonia to urea, which is then excreted in urine, and metabolizes drugs and detoxifies chemicals.
 
• It helps in the regulation of blood clotting and removes bacteria from the bloodstream.
